The girl, now wearing a black zip-up jacket with a purple logo, is singing expressively. In the background, there are dense green trees and a blurred view of a river and a bridge. (3) The video cuts back to the indoor studio. The girl wears the same blue and white athletic shirt and black headphones. She sings directly into a professional white condenser microphone mounted on a boom arm. The lighting is bright and even across the scene. (4) The camera cuts to the man outdoors in the park. He wears a black baseball cap and a black jacket over a white t-shirt. He sings with high emotional energy, gesturing with his hands as he performs. The background shows lush greenery and soft natural light. (5) In the studio, the man is shown wearing his white cap and light blue shirt. He sings while looking at a smartphone mounted on a stand in front of him. He is wearing white wired earbuds. The studio wall behind him is plain and white. (6) The girl is shown singing outdoors on a wooden boardwalk or deck near a body of water. She looks around while singing, and the background includes a metal railing and blurred figures of people sitting at tables in the distance under a cloudy sky. (7) The final phase returns to the studio where both the girl and the man are present. The man smiles at the camera and gives a thumbs-up while holding the small microphone cord. The girl is smiling next to him, and the shot is a medium close-up.
